messages:
Maya Chen: hey team — thinking a low-key mocktail mixer + plant-based potluck + boardgame night next week? :sparkles: 
Maya Chen: date options: Thu 6:30pm or Fri 7pm. Venue: office rooftop or Bayview lounge. thoughts? :beer: (mocktails only obvs)
Kevin O'Rourke: love this. friday 7 works for me. rooftop pls if weather holds. :+1:
Priya Desai: Fri 7 is my vote too. can bring a big tray of roasted veg skewers (vegan). :leafy_green:
Jonah Park: Thu 6:30 better for me but can do Fri if most people prefer. i can bring Settlers of Catan and Sushi Go party deck.
Anya S.: i'd rather Friday — fewer calendar conflicts. i'll bring dessert (vegan chocolate mousse) and some non-alcoholic ginger spritz mix. :yum:
Maya Chen: awesome. ok looks like Fri 7 rooftop is the winner so far. @here if you haven't said, drop a reaction or quick note with what you'll bring and any dietary constraints.
Kevin O'Rourke: bringing chips + hummus (gf). allergic to tree nuts — heads up.
Priya Desai: noted. can anyone bring plates/cutlery? i have one set but not enough for ~20.
Jonah Park: i've got 10 compostable plates and some bamboo cutlery, i'll bring them.
Anya S.: quick poll idea — what games do people want? 1) Catan 2) Codenames 3) Uno 4) Jackbox (need laptop + tv). reply with numbers
Maya Chen: 1,2,4 from me. also if folks want quieter option we can do a chill playlist + table-top card games.
Kevin O'Rourke: 2 and 3 for me. maybe split into two tables?
Priya Desai: i'm down for Codenames or Jackbox.
Jonah Park: i'll run Catan table, Maya you ok to host Jackbox setup? need a laptop + hdmi.
Maya Chen: yep i can bring laptop + hdmi. thanks!
calendar-bot: Event created: "Mocktail Mixer & Plant Potluck" — Fri 7:00PM at Rooftop Lounge. RSVP: 18/25.
Maya Chen: perfect. i'll post a quick signup sheet (google form) for contributions and dietary notes, will drop link here in a bit. :memo: 
Anya S.: gif: :party-parrot:  (can't wait)
Kevin O'Rourke: cheers to snacks and mocktails. see you all Friday! :tada:
